# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting T3 Pretty to the fork maintainer via GitHub Security
Advisories at https://github.com/SergeSerb2/t3-pretty/security/advisories or by contacting the
repository owner. Please do not disclose them publicly until the maintainer has had a reasonable
opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

For vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code or T3 Tools-operated infrastructure, see the
[upstream security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).
